news.signals

Signal handlers that keep each user’s permission group in sync with role.

Functions

assign_role_group

Put a user in the permission group that matches their role.

configure_role_group

Create or update the permission group for a role.

role_changed

Return whether a saved user's role differs from the stored one.

Details

news.signals.configure_role_group(role)[source]

Create or update the permission group for a role.

Parameters:

role (str) – A value from news.models.User.Roles.

Returns:

The group named after the role, with its permissions set to match that role.

Return type:

django.contrib.auth.models.Group

news.signals.role_changed(instance, update_fields=None)[source]

Return whether a saved user’s role differs from the stored one.

Parameters:

  • instance (news.models.User) – The user that was saved.

  • update_fields (frozenset, optional) – The fields passed to save(update_fields=...), or None for a full save.

Returns:

False if the save could not have changed the role (for example the last_login update made at sign-in), otherwise whether the role differs from the one loaded from the database.

Return type:

bool

news.signals.assign_role_group(sender, instance, created=False, update_fields=None, **kwargs)[source]

Put a user in the permission group that matches their role.

Connected to post_save for news.models.User. The group is only rebuilt when the user is created or their role changes, not on every save.

Parameters:

  • sender (type) – The model class that sent the signal.

  • instance (news.models.User) – The user that was saved.

  • created (bool) – True if the user was just created.

  • update_fields (frozenset, optional) – Fields named in save(update_fields=...), or None.

  • **kwargs – Extra signal arguments (unused).
